Hi Jordan — thanks for sharing the questionnaire and the pen test summary. A few clarifying points from our side so you have a sense of coverage before we share any full reports under NDA: 

- SOC 2: confirmation appreciated — we will review the bridge letter and summary once shared.
- Pen test sharing: we require an executed NDA for full reports; once NDA is in place, we can exchange full artifacts. If you prefer, we can provide a scoped executive summary and a CVE extract (remediated vs open) ahead of the NDA.
- Scanning cadence: Redwood runs weekly external scans (authenticated and unauthenticated where applicable), continuous dependency/CVE monitoring, and quarterly internal scanning. External pen tests are annual or ad-hoc tied to major releases.
- Remediation SLA: critical: 72 hours; high: 7 days; medium: 30 days; low: planned next release. We track remediation via our ticketing system and publish a disclosure timeline for public CVEs.

On disclosure: we practice coordinated disclosure and expect customers to follow a 30-day public disclosure window for newly discovered critical findings unless there is active mitigation in place. We can share our disclosure policy doc in the NDA package.

I can take the lead on a short technical sync — available Wed 4/7 09:00-09:30 PT or Thu 4/8 11:00-11:30 PT. Let me know which works and I will send a calendar invite and an expectation doc.

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
